This synthetic fixture was authored for Burr under its MIT terms and contains
no third-party CAD geometry. The generator records an OCCT-valid radius-10,
height-1 cylinder and a 1 × 500 × 0.6 planar box starting at (9.8, -250, 0.2).
Their exact common volume is positive. Translating the box 0.2 along X gives
tangent contact. The large planar extent must not add curved sampling error.
